findings.title: The concurrency test does not wait for the reader thread
findings.body: The reader thread is started but never joined before the test checks `caughtExceptions`. The deletion loop can finish and the assertion can run while a group-list request is still in flight, so an exception caused by the race may be added only after the assertion and the test will pass. The reader may also be scheduled only after deletion has completed, meaning the test can pass without exercising concurrent access. Coordinate the reader and deleter so overlap is guaranteed, then stop and join the reader before asserting its result.
